description: Public repo; main is gated by a ruleset requiring the CI result check. no-automerge is extended last so Renovate never merges its own PRs: nothing here is deployed by CI, since pin bumps land as PRs and get rebuilt on the laptop by hand. GitHub auto-merge is still enabled on the repo, for use manually on a PR once its checks pass.

customManagers.description: images.json's pinned public MCP images -- registry/repo:tag pairs with no Dockerfile of their own.
backstage-mcp-server/Dockerfile's upstream pin -- upstream ships no releases, so this is a git-refs pin against main, same shape as the terraform-modules pin used fleet-wide.
oci-mcp/Dockerfile's upstream pin -- same shape as backstage-mcp-server's above, upstream ships no releases either.
